text: Weapons. Is that what you think I am?
He's helped every person in this city, and that's what you lead with?
He's trying to help us. Stop it.
Thank you.
Somebody had to say it out loud. Thank you.
Get them out. All of them. Even the ones who'd never do the same for me.
There were synths down there who never chose any of this.
He made me. He picked which memories I'd get. He picked you.
And I still want to hold him. How is that fair?
Because he's yours too. Whatever that means now.
I'm not setting foot in that place again unless I have to. Not while he's in charge.
People helping people. I can get behind that.
This was the right choice. Out of all of them.
It really was.
They don't even ask what I am. They just ask if I'm safe.
Synths like me get to choose now. Rights. Freedom. Imagine that.
She's right. They're good people.
They'd shoot me on sight if they knew. You know that, right?
They're our best chance at finding Shaun.
A steel hand. Sure. But at what cost?
Nobody's touching you. Not while I'm here.
Better you than him. It still hurts, though.
For both of us.
There were good people up there. I still feel safer.
A lot of good people.
The Commonwealth will be better without them.
It will.
He didn't know either. Thank you for not making him pay for it.
He served them his whole life. This is how they repay him.
Good job, sweetie.
You let them keep her. You let them keep testing.
He ran. I'd have run too.
